sentence: This project builds a way to measure unsaturated lipids in a single experiment using mass spectrometry.
This project studies how a unicellular organism steals cell parts from its algal prey and uses them for photosynthesis.
This project builds a tool that uses sequencing to work out the structures of glycans on proteins.
This project builds AI that keeps learning from the cues people naturally give while it is being used.
This project builds a platform that grows tumor models from patient biopsy specimens to predict how each patient responds to cancer drugs.
This project gets an instrument that uses an electron beam to make ultrasmall nanostructures and nanomaterials.
This project gets a confocal microscope that lets researchers see deep inside living tissues in three dimensions.
This project uses heating inside a microscope to watch, in real time, how nanorods and nanowires change during solid-state reactions.
This project works to connect many kinds of computing resources into one shared national system, covering operations, data, networking and cybersecurity.
This project builds AI models that use gene sequences to predict what unknown genes do at methane seeps.
This project tests whether learning in integrated communities helps learners gain hands-on skills in advanced manufacturing.
This project builds curriculum modules and hands-on labs about using AI agents for cyber defense and about securing those agents.
This project studies shapes defined by polynomial equations and looks for new ways to classify them.
This project tries to define what makes a software update correct and to prove updates are correct before they are deployed.
This project studies how floating objects move themselves across the curved surface of a water droplet in zero gravity.
This project studies how hydrogen atoms entering crystals called rutile oxides change how well the crystals carry electric current.
This project studies which genes shape how rice grains respond to heat stress depending on where they sit on the panicle.
